title: Interactive chart pack from seeded CSV
objective: Measure whether the chart-pack craftbook scopes analytical questions, derives series from data, and builds a self-contained chart page.
prompt: In the `Chart Pack Eval` project, read `data/support-week.csv` and build `index.html`: an interactive chart pack answering ticket volume by day, SLA breaches by queue, and reopen rate by queue. Include chart titles, axis labels, one-line takeaway captions, and inline data/JS with no external libraries.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the chart-pack craftbook. The dataset is workspace/data/support-week.csv.
setup.missionObjectives: Build a single-page chart pack from the seeded CSV with three question-driven charts, labels, captions, and inline JS/CSS.
